dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail Message Board
dialogues.text: If you have anything to share, be it brooding or joyous, distressing or hilarious, write them down on our Message Board! Cat's Tail is all cat ears!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When did Cat's Tail hire such a great bartender? She's not only pretty, but also amazing at her job..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But... why would praising her enrage her? I just can't wrap my head around it..."

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: Please don't dwell on the reasons behind it... If you wish to support her, what better way than to come here often?
